legal_dmca_body: If you believe content on this site infringes your copyright, email us with: where the infringing content is, proof of your rights, and how to contact you. We'll review it and take down content confirmed to be infringing.
legal_dmca_intro: {siteName} respects copyright. Here's how rights holders can report infringement. This translation is for reference; the Chinese version prevails.
legal_dmca_meta_description: How to send a DMCA notice to {siteName}.
legal_privacy_choices_body: You can draw sticks and explore the market for free without signing in. You only need to sign in with your email to save in-depth readings or make a wish at the Wishing Pond. You can sign out at any time, or email us to delete your account.
legal_privacy_collect_body: Drawing sticks, casting moon blocks and reading verdicts don't require sign-in: the sticks you draw are stored only in your own browser and never sent to our servers. After you sign in (email code, no password), we keep: your email, purchase history, unlocked in-depth readings and generated reports, wishes you write at the Wishing Pond, and the dates of your daily heart-note check-ins (only which days you checked in). Your email is only used for sign-in codes and necessary transaction notices — never marketing emails.
legal_privacy_cookies_body: We use cookies to remember your language preference and, once you sign in, your sign-in status (first-party only, not readable by browser scripts). No cross-site tracking and no ad trackers.
legal_privacy_intro: {siteName} collects only the data needed to provide the service. Here's how we handle it. This translation is for reference; the Chinese version prevails.
legal_privacy_meta_description: How {siteName} collects, uses and protects your data.
legal_privacy_processors_body: Accounts and data are stored with Supabase (database and authentication); the site is hosted by Cloudflare; sign-in codes are sent through Google's email service (Gmail). Payments are processed by Stripe, which collects your card number directly — we never see it; in some regions Stripe collects local sales tax as the merchant of record. See "Paid in-depth readings" below for how readings are generated.
legal_privacy_retention_body: When you're not signed in, your stick history lives only in your browser and is gone when you clear browser data. Once signed in, your account data, purchases and reports are kept so you can look them up later; you can email us at any time to delete your account and all records, which can't be undone. Transaction records that must be kept by law are retained at Stripe.
legal_refunds_body: Digital content can't be refunded once delivered, with these exceptions: duplicate charges; or the reading never generates or can't be read after a successful payment. If consumer protection law where you live gives you more rights, local law applies.
legal_refunds_duplicate_body: If the same unlock was charged twice, we'll refund the extra charge. Email us with your order number.
legal_refunds_how_body: Email us with your order number and the issue. We'll reply and resolve it within 7 business days.
legal_refunds_intro: What you pay for is "in-depth reading" digital content: generated by AI from the stick you drew and the question you wrote, delivered as soon as payment is confirmed, and kept in your account to read anytime. This translation is for reference; the Chinese version prevails.
legal_refunds_meta_description: Refund rules for paid unlocks on {siteName}.
legal_terms_body: Stick verses and readings on this site are for reference only and are not life, relationship, medical, legal or financial advice. Whether to believe them and how to act is up to you.
legal_terms_intro: Please read these terms before using {siteName}. This translation is for reference; the Chinese version prevails.
legal_terms_liability_body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, this site is not responsible for decisions made based on stick verses or readings.
legal_terms_payment_body: Prices are shown in US dollars and include tax; nothing is added at checkout. In-depth readings are a one-time payment with permanent access and never auto-renew; question-pack credits don't expire and are used one at a time. Payments are processed by Stripe.
legal_terms_use_body: Drawing sticks, casting moon blocks and reading verdicts are free and need no sign-in. Buying in-depth readings and making wishes at the Wishing Pond require sign-in. Wishes at the pond are visible to everyone: don't include full names, phone numbers, account handles or other personal details of yourself or others, and don't write harassment, abuse or sexual content; we'll hide or delete unsuitable wishes. Don't use automated programs to draw sticks or register in bulk; we reserve the right to limit abuse.
